title: Operando XAS and DFT Uncover Structure-Performance Relationships in Re/TiO₂ for Selective CO₂ Hydrogenation to Methanol
extraction_notes: No SI figures contain measured catalytic-performance data points for this work to digitise. SI Figures S1–S10 and S17–S26 are characterization/DFT figures. SI Figure S8 includes reaction conditions for operando XANES but plots only XANES derivatives, not CO2 conversion/selectivity/STY. SI Figures S11–S16 plot thermodynamic-equilibrium/simulated CO2 conversion or selectivity and were skipped under the rules for simulated/modelled/equilibrium curves.
